provenance.attribution: "Animated Base Character" by Quaternius, via Poly Pizza — licensed CC BY 3.0. Bones remapped and clips renamed for Browser Smash; geometry unchanged.
provenance.notes: Poly Pizza lists this model as Creative Commons Attribution (CC BY 3.0), NOT the CC0 most Quaternius packs use, so attribution is required. Geometry, rig and animation remain the author's work; this pipeline renames nodes and clips and adds one scaling wrapper node.

clipNotes.Kick: The source pack has no kick animation. Punch_Cross is substituted and must be replaced with a real kick before this body is treated as shippable.
clipNotes.Kamehameha: Spell_Simple_Shoot is the closest cast-and-release motion in the pack; it is a stand-in, not a Kamehameha.
clipNotes.Run: Sprint_Loop rather than Jog_Fwd_Loop, because the game's Run state is a sprint.
